### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Set an organization model as the default through agent-manager](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3493) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On the page of an organization's model, organization admins can use `Set as default` again, which moves the organization's default to that model. A model whose key is missing opens the credential form first.
